title: Free To Be Me
about: Stepping into who I am without apology.
description: This track closes on identity, freedom, and self-acceptance. After everything before it, this song represents reaching a place where I can stand as myself more fully, without hiding, bending, or being defined only by what happened to me.
lyrics: Intro
Yeah, right now this is exactly who I am
Verse 1
I walk in, take a second just to read the room
I don’t rush, I observe, I decide my move
When I know what I’m dealing with I take control
Flip the switch, lock it in, now I run the flow
I don’t need validation, I already know
What I bring, how I think, how I let it go
I play it smart, I adapt, I don’t force the scene
Find my lane, make it mine, keep it sharp and clean
Pre-Chorus
I don’t wait around for someone else to choose
If I need it, I’ll ask, otherwise I move
Everything I am is something I control
Chorus
I’m free to dress how I want, I don’t follow a line
I’m free to do it my way every step, every time
No voice telling me who I should try to be
I decide what I am, I’m just free to be me
Verse 2
I can stand out loud or blend into the scene
Either way I stay exactly who I mean
I don’t chase attention, I don’t need the noise
I stay focused on my path, on my own choice
Logic in my head but I trust what I feel
If it matters I step up, make it real
Lead when I need to, step back when I don’t
I know when to push and I know when I won’t
Pre-Chorus
I don’t bend just to fit into a frame
I adjust, I adapt, but I stay the same
Everything I am is something I control
Chorus
I’m free to dress how I want, I don’t follow a line
I’m free to do it my way every step, every time
No voice telling me who I should try to be
I decide what I am, I’m just free to be me
Bridge
No hesitation when I know what I’m about
No second guessing, no need to figure out
I move clean, I stay sharp, I keep it mine
Everything I do is on my time
Final Chorus
I’m free to dress how I want, I don’t follow a line
I’m free to do it my way every step, every time
No voice telling me who I should try to be
I decide what I am, I’m just free to be me
Outro
Yeah, this is who I am and I’m not changing it
I live it how I want, every day I’m claiming it
No limits on me, no one else I need to be
I’m exactly who I am — free to be me
